About us

One team for everything, from the first plan to the final finish.

At Ashiyana Interiors we plan and execute complete interiors for homes and shops. You deal with one point of contact instead of coordinating separate contractors for civil, electrical, carpentry and painting.

01

We listen firstYour routine, your taste and your budget shape the design.

02

Clear planningLayout, materials and finishes are agreed before work begins.

03

Careful finishingDetails like edges, joints and lighting get proper attention.

Services

Everything your space needs, in one place

Interior design & work

Complete home and office interiors, planned around how you live and built to the approved design.

Modular kitchen

Smart layouts, durable finishes and storage that makes daily cooking easier.

Bedrooms & wardrobes

Restful bedrooms with custom wardrobes and storage, finished to match the room.

Designer false ceiling

Layered ceilings with soft cove lighting that give rooms depth.

Painting, tiles & wallpaper

Walls and floors finished properly with paint, tiling and wallpaper.

WPC louvers

Modern wood-look louvers and paneling for feature walls and partitions.

Also: civil work, construction and electrical work, handled by the same team that does your interiors.
